motif: A glowing Turquesa de Válvula (#1CC8B4) valve handwheel or gauge-eye, a spoked ring, set high on every building, with black Breu Abissal oil-weep streaks running down the body from it. The race trim is riveted naval plate.

buildings.colour: salmon-pink coral concrete with dark plate seams
buildings.why: The card gives a stepped pyramid. Its apex handwheel is the biggest motif mark in the race.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Three dead-coral spires frame the hanging bell over the ossuary base. The result is a jagged pale cluster, not a tower.

buildings.colour: oil-black iron with a glossy sheen
buildings.why: It keeps the Swamp Well chain archetype and grows it. Three S-curved hoses lean outward around a central drill-bit obelisk.
The card gives a half-dome turtle shell sunk in slime, so the silhouette is a low, wide hump.
It keeps the chain's dome and grows it into a fused hull with a keel stair and a palisade deck. The brown timber also separates it from the village.
It keeps the chain's dome and grows it with three stacked huts on stilts and a sail awning. The leaning tin tower reads as a bumpy dome.
The cracked basin is mostly below ground. A rim with a gramophone-conch over the spout marks it at 40 px.
The open tridacna fans out as wings, and the holding pen at the foot widens the footprint. It reads as a flat star.
The circular tank with a coral rim shows a dark hollow centre. The dock portal notch adds to the ring shape.
It keeps the Spawning Grounds drum and grows it with a truncated pyramid crown. The darker plate makes it read as an upgrade.
The circular slab with a hatch is a low drum with a dark vapour hole on top.
The beam pump and crooked pipe tilt over the well mouth. This is the base the Lernaean Fountain grows from.
It keeps the Temple of Snakes gate and grows it into a taller conch portal on anchor legs with a launch beam reaching out.
The open portico on anchor pillars is a hanging porch with a clear see-through gap.
The upright pipe elbow with a figurehead is the tallest and narrowest shape in the race.
